description: Find relevant Reddit discussions for a topic: up to 15 threads with summaries, subreddits and links, 3 of them read in full for the post text, author, age, score, comment count and sampled comments. coverage and warnings report anything that could not be read. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

topic.description: Topic, category, product, or audience to research on Reddit.

name: cite42_reddit_trends
